lyrics.text: You leave your umbrella by my chair again pretending it was extra just a lucky accident
I fold the handle twice then hide it in my sleeve so you won't see the little proof
I don't want you to leave I call you careless when you notice every
Bruce, you say my name so softly that I forget what to accuse
I save the last strawberry from the cake for you then told you it was sour so you wouldn't guess it's true
If I turn away it's only so you won't see how every small panic this rearrange is me
I don't need a gramp hooray or promises that shine just keep choosing to seep beside me
And I'll keep choosing mine
I'll memorize your train times then complain you came too soon
I leave the porch like burning underneath the paper mud
When winter finds your fingers I land you my warm gloves then swear they're much too itchy for somebody that I
You ask me why I'm waiting by the gate at quarter past eight
I say I hate the quiet here don't make me say I stayed
I save the last strawberry from the cake for you then told you it was sour so you wouldn't guess it's true
If I turn away it's only so you won't see how every small panic this rearrange is me
I don't need a gramp hooray or promises that shine just keep choosing to seep beside me
And I'll keep choosing mine
Listen don't laugh don't make me take it back
I practice these four words until they lost the shape when your day is heavy bring it to my door
You don't have to earn the place I've kept for you before
And if my voice goes small please understand
I'm not pushing you away I'm reaching for your hand
So stay stay stay until the morning trains begin
I drew your name and pencil then I drew it once again
My heart is loud my pride is paper then if you call this foolish like the foolishness begin
And I won't hide behind a frown I won't turn the sin to war you or the person I was saving all my ordinary days for
I save the last strawberry the sweetest one I know and this time when you take it I'll admit I saved it for you
Let my cheeks become a secret neither of us has to keep some feelings growing silence
Then awake us from our sleep no gramp hooray no perfect line no promise carved in stone
Just your shoulder next to my making anywhere feel home tomorrow I may tease you just to keep my balance true
But bring your umbrella darling I made room here for you
Tomorrow I may tease you just to keep my balance true
